assay_protocol.aggregation: 216 rows are reduced within seed; aggregate mean and sample SEM use four seed-level values

decoder.features: ReLU(rate+Gaussian noise), per-trial L1 then L2
decoder.name: condition-blind, noise-held-out orientation decoding
decoder.paired_noise: same A/B noise table within each split

assay_protocol.feedback_execution: normal feedback-on unroll in both conditions

data_flow: final checkpoints -> standalone per-seed assay JSON -> this six-alpha aggregate

metric_definitions.decode_accuracy_A: condition-blind, noise-held-out orientation accuracy for continuation A
metric_definitions.decode_accuracy_B: condition-blind, noise-held-out orientation accuracy for OOD reversal B
metric_definitions.final_mean_rate_A: mean final L2/3 rate under operational continuation A
metric_definitions.final_mean_rate_B: mean final L2/3 rate under matched operational OOD reversal B
metric_definitions.fraction_pairs_B_greater_A: fraction of matched pairs with final_mean_rate_B > final_mean_rate_A
metric_definitions.population_alignment_A: circular population-vector alignment for continuation A
metric_definitions.population_alignment_B: circular population-vector alignment for OOD reversal B

provenance.portability: no absolute source paths or usernames stored

scope_limit: Only fields recorded by standalone endpoint_assay.json are aggregated; unavailable all-alpha raw profiles are not reconstructed.
